# Brett Chalupa

> > Personal site of Brett Chalupa: software developer, indie game creator, and creative writer working with Ruby on Rails, Rust, DragonRuby, Playdate/Lua, and Godot.

Brett is a Pennsylvania-based developer who creates games, writes sci-fi short stories, publishes zines and comics, and produces programming tutorials. His work spans web development (Ruby on Rails, Rust), game development (DragonRuby, Godot, Playdate SDK), and creative writing.

## Key Topics

- Ruby on Rails
- RSpec testing
- DragonRuby game toolkit
- Playdate SDK and Lua
- Godot Engine
- Rust programming
- Indie game development
- Sokoban games (SokoWorld)
- Test-driven development (TDD)
- Capybara feature testing
- Digital zines and comics
- Sci-fi short stories
- Open source software
- Programming screencasts
- Web development tutorials

## Main Pages

- [Brett Chalupa](https://brettchalupa.com): Homepage: creative dabbler & software dev with Playdate/Lua projects
- [About](https://brettchalupa.com/about): Software developer & creative from Pennsylvania; vegan, reader, filmmaker
- [Works](https://brettchalupa.com/works): Portfolio of creative projects: Playdate/Lua book, Godot tutorials, games
- [Projects](https://brettchalupa.com/projects): Technical portfolio: charity:water apps, Burlington Ruby Conference, more

## Game Development

- [Brett Makes Games](https://games.brettchalupa.com): Game dev homepage featuring SokoWorld, an open source Sokoban client
- [Games Portfolio](https://games.brettchalupa.com/games): Portfolio of indie games: SokoWorld, Destroy All Goblins, tutorials
- [Small Games](https://brettchalupa.com/small-games): Free browser games collection with YouTube dev log series
- [About Game Development](https://games.brettchalupa.com/about): About Brett as a hobbyist game developer with 15 years experience

## Programming Tutorials & Screencasts

- [Brett Codes](https://code.brettchalupa.com): Programming screencasts & tutorials on Ruby on Rails, Rust, and more
- [Test Driven RSpec Series](https://code.brettchalupa.com/test-driven-rspec): 7-part screencast series on TDD with RSpec and Ruby on Rails
- [RSpec Test Doubles Explained](https://code.brettchalupa.com/rspec-test-doubles-explained): Guide to using test doubles and mocking in RSpec for unit testing
- [spec_helper vs rails_helper](https://code.brettchalupa.com/spec_helper-vs-rails_helper-explained): Explains RSpec helper files difference in Rails testing configuration
- [Git Bisect for Bug Fixing](https://code.brettchalupa.com/quickly-fix-bugs-with-git-bisect): Guide to using Git Bisect for efficient bug hunting and debugging
- [Dark Mode with CSS](https://code.brettchalupa.com/supporting-dark-mode-with-css): Tutorial on implementing dark mode with prefers-color-scheme media query
- [Capybara Basics](https://code.brettchalupa.com/test-driven-rspec-episode-05): Tutorial on Capybara basics for Rails feature testing with RSpec
